audit.why: Galio favoured pre-6 by walking through Hwei's poke with W and closing with E; the level chart (all Galio) matches the packet.
Spikes at level 2 (W blocks poke), level 6 (R engage onto an immobile target), and first item (W-E all-in) are all grounded in Hwei having zero dash/blink in his kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every writable field names Hwei's CC ability as 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)', which does not exist in his kit. The real ability, per the brief's authoritative slot names, is Subject: Torment (E) — his root/fear crowd control.
audit.why: The packet defect explicitly flags that no writable field names any of Hwei's real abilities. Subject: Torment is the E slot and carries hardCC/slow flags in the kit, matching the 'CC lives here' framing already in the text.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Subject: Torment (E)' everywhere it appears.

edits.after: Sponge the poke and taunt the plan. Track Subject: Torment (E) before every commit and keep the lane where your duo’s pattern works.

edits.after: - Galio vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E). - Engage when their answer is down — the chain only needs one clean start. - Engage only on Subject: Torment (E)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.

notes: Primary fix is the packet-flagged defect: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is fabricated and does not exist in Hwei's kit; replaced with the real ability, Subject: Torment (E), everywhere it appeared (winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0/2].d, report[5].t, report[9].t).
